title: FindingRef
description: Reference to a finding (Variant, Biomarker, etc.) within the same NgsInterpretationResponse. Used by recommendations to point at the variants/biomarkers that triggered the rule. The shared FindingRef definition lives here so it can be reused across cdx-flag, contraindication, trial-match, and recommendation.

refType.description: Which top-level array the referenced finding lives in.

refId.description: UUID of the referenced finding (variantId, biomarkerId, or cdxFlagId).
